title.narrative: Nepal Samartha (“Empowered”): Enhancing Gender & Human Development Outcomes through Systems Strengthening

description.narrative: The Samartha: Enhancing Gender and Human Development Outcomes through System Strengthening Programme (Samartha), funded by the British Embassy Kathmandu (BEK), aims to strengthen the capacity of provincial and local governments to effectively carry out their constitutional mandate. The programme focuses on improving access to quality social services, particularly for women, girls, and marginalised groups, including Dalits and other minorities. This will be complemented by federal-level support to ensure that national sectoral policies and resource allocations are responsive to local needs. This approach promotes resilient social systems that enhance health, education, and gender equality outcomes.

The objective of this Contract is to contribute to the delivery of Samartha’s high-level outcome, which is the sustainable and equitable delivery of human development commitments and constitutional mandates for social services by the Government (across the three tiers of federalised Nepal). This will be done by promoting more inclusive and accountable institutions that respond to Nepal’s interrelated governance challenges, with a focus on social sectors.
